context.focus: Reuse versioned common SOP templates without copying over product-specific behavior.
forbidden_scope: deleting or replacing prior architecture artifacts
design work before workflow contracts pass
invented market demand, search volume, customers, reviews, rankings, backlinks, citations, or performance
mass-generated public pages or keyword permutations

definition_of_done: Every common SOP references a versioned common-library template.
Owners, inputs, outputs, controls, metrics, and exception paths are explicit.
Adaptations retain the common template id and version for future migration.

After the owned section passes, append or update agent_evidence for common_sop_catalog_agent with status done, at least one scoped check in checks_passed, and an empty checks_failed list. Unfinished downstream stages are dependencies, not failures of this task.
